ess.name: ESS
ess.title: E-Invoicing & E-Receipts
ess.description: A flexible cloud platform to issue and manage e-invoices and e-receipts from anywhere, right from your browser — no software installation needed.
features: Full flexibility issuing invoices and receipts on the web
Access the system from mobile, tablet, or desktop
Instant automatic updates in line with tax authority decisions
Regular automatic backups of your sales data

ers.name: ERS
ers.title: POS E-Receipts
ers.description: The fastest digital solution for managing web-based point-of-sale and retail, built specifically for one-tap e-receipt issuance.
features: Direct, real-time link to the tax authority for receipts
A very simple interface built specifically for POS
Full support for cashier devices and thermal printers
Real-time tracking of daily sales from anywhere

esa.name: ESA
esa.title: E-Signature & E-Stamp
esa.description: The specialized tool for linking e-signatures and e-stamps to tax systems, ensuring the legality and reliability of every document.
features: Full support for all e-signature and e-stamp certificates in Egypt
High-level encryption to protect digital data
Fast, easy integration with various invoicing systems
Alerts ahead of digital certificate renewal dates
